_comment: Squad Battles: daily generated CPU opponents and the match venue shared with Draft. Changing opponents or slot positions changes the squads generated for the current day.
_venueComment: Matches are played at physical venue 2 (Santiago Bernabeu, stadium card asset 1): away fixtures cannot resolve their venue in the retail client, so the user always stays home.
_opponentKitsComment: Installed kits worn by every opponent so they never clash with the club's strips.
_squadComment: Positions accepted by each of the 23 slots of a generated 4-4-2 squad (11 starters, 12 substitutes). Only base cards (rareflag 0 or 1) rated at least candidateMinRating are used: promo ids make the pre-match flow wait forever on unavailable player heads.
_eventComment: The always-open competition window around the current time.
_legacyFeedComment: The generic opponent feed served on older Squad Battles paths.
_itemIdsComment: Synthetic item id ranges for generated opponent items. CardsDLL caches active items by id, so these must never overlap owned club items.
